# Verifiko

> Verifiko checks whether a link is safe. Paste a URL and get an explainable verdict in
> seconds (a 0-100 trust score, a risk level from SAFE to CRITICAL, and the signals behind
> it) for phishing, scams and malware. The same engine is available through a REST API.

Detection combines deterministic URL, page and TLS heuristics, brand-typosquatting checks,
domain age and reputation feeds (URLhaus, OpenPhish). Signed-in users can request a deep
scan that opens the page in an isolated headless browser and returns a screenshot.
Verdicts are available in English and Spanish.

## Product

- [Verifiko](https://www.verifiko.es/): landing page and overview
- [Verify a link](https://www.verifiko.es/app): the web app; anonymous checks have a daily limit
- [Service status](https://www.verifiko.es/api-health): live API health check

## Developers

- [API reference](https://github.com/hbonavota/verifiko/blob/main/docs/API.md): authentication, synchronous verifications, async scans, webhooks, quotas and errors
- [API base URL](https://api.verifiko.es/api/v1): versioned REST API; requests use an API key (`X-API-Key`)
- [Source code](https://github.com/hbonavota/verifiko): Apache-2.0
